|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Virtual Block 1)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-107-Obi_Wan_Kenobi-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-107-Obi_Wan_Kenobi.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-obiwankenobi-pre.gif]]) show the original text; see [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Virtual Block 1)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text): “Obi-Wan's game text may not be canceled and he may not be targeted by cards that capture. Unless another Jedi present, may Force drain here regardless of Objective restrictions. Immune to attrition < 5 (< 8 if with a Dark Jedi).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 107. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cl-1210_107-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “may not be” to “may never be”. PC-E1 text: “Obi-Wan's game text may not be canceled and he may never be targeted by cards that capture. Unless another Jedi present, may Force drain here regardless of Objective restrictions. Immune to attrition < 5 (< 8 if with a Dark Jedi).”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12, page 12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 13 January 2014, in its “final big batch of errata before the MPC” (“Obi-Wan's game text may not be canceled and he may never be targeted by cards that capture. [Previous text continues.]”)<ref name="pcforum-p860688">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 13 January 2014 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p860688 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then (the Master List that prints it was compiled until February 2014).
